title: Amazon Built Its Own Delivery Army. Then It Won.
source: Pitney Bowes Parcel Shipping Index annual reports (as covered by Supply Chain Dive, Retail Dive and Modern Shipper/FreightWaves) tracking US parcel volume by carrier. Amazon Logistics (in-house last-mile delivery): 1.9B (2019), 4.2B (2020), 4.8B (2021), 4.8B (2022), 5.9B (2023), 6.3B (2024). UPS US parcel volume: 4.7B (2019), 4.9B (2020), 5.3B (2021), 5.2B (2022), 4.6B (2023), 4.7B (2024). FedEx US parcel volume: 3.0B (2019), 3.7B (2020), 4.2B (2021), 4.1B (2022), 3.9B (2023), 3.7B (2024). Amazon Logistics passed FedEx in 2020 and passed UPS in 2023 to become the largest single US parcel carrier by volume (behind only USPS).
